chunks: 1414 - Zurarah narrated from him that he said:

key_terms.الصَّلَوَاتِ: the prayers; the ritual salat prayers
key_terms.الْقُنُوتُ: qunoot; the supplication recited in prayer
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurarah, the narrator transmitting this report

ai.seo_question: Is qunoot recited in all prayers according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that qunoot is prescribed in all prayers. It indicates a general legal ruling concerning the place of supplication within salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1414 - Zurarah narrated from Him (Imam Abu Ja'far (as)) that He said:
"Qunoot (a supplication) is to be recited in all prayers."
